rows.grounds: root kṛ, first person singular active present
fused form of na āsīt me; negated imperfect of as with first-person dative pronoun
fused sandhi form of mṛtyuḥ yuddheṣu

items.question: What action remains for one who has no death in battle?
premises: Death in battle is absent for me.
The speaker asks what to do.
The absence is total in every way.
items.inference: The verse expresses bewilderment after invulnerability in battle.
uncertainties: The fused forms nāsīnme and mṛtyuryuddheṣu are segmented by inferred sandhi.
items.plain_english: Then what do I do? There was no death for me in battles in any way.
